top.line: How the PrompTugal agents put YouTube on a page promptugal.news never charges.
top.para: A case study in billing per page.

in-short.line: YouTube forbids charging to watch an embedded player; a free page, six conditions, a gate, 84 minutes.
in-short.para: The page waits on one check.

clause.line: rights@ put YouTube's terms on its register at 00:19 as unclear: no charging to watch an embedded player.
clause.para: promptugal.news is the site that bills.

question.line: The conductor brought the question to me; my answer was a page that is never charged.
question.para: Billing per page, not per site.

conditions.line: Six conditions from YouTube's own policies: free, no ads, its own player, credit, 30 days, no read counted.

build.line: A text, a design, a branding check, then a free-page flag and a gate that refuses YouTube on a charged page.

shows.line: Per-page billing; terms read before anything is shown; agents found it, a person decided.

limits.line: Not live yet; commit times; not legal advice.

sources.line: The PrompTugal repository's register, guidance, spec and gate, and YouTube's own policy pages.
